WELCOME250.title: WELCOME250: ₹250 off your first order
WELCOME250.terms:
Use WELCOME250 at checkout for ₹250 off your first purchase of ₹1,499 or more.
The minimum spend is calculated on merchandise at current selling prices. Delivery charges do not count.
One use per new customer. Sign in with your verified mobile number.
Cannot be combined with GET1, another promotional coupon or HIDI reward redemption. One offer per order.
Prices include applicable taxes. Existing delivery charges apply.
Returns & exchanges
Eligible items may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused, unworn and unwashed, with original tags and packaging, and are subject to inspection.
Return pickup and size exchanges are free. Size exchanges depend on replacement stock availability.
Refunds are processed within 3–5 days after inspection confirms the returned item is unused and undamaged.
For a wrong, damaged or missing item, keep the packaging, order number and clear photos. These cases are reviewed separately from preference-based returns.

GET1.title: GET1: An extra dress for just ₹1
GET1.terms:
Use GET1 at checkout when regular merchandise totals ₹3,999 or more at current selling prices.
Choose one additional dress and an available size from the selected GET1 collection for ₹1. Other dresses are not included.
The ₹1 dress and delivery charges do not count toward the ₹3,999 minimum.
Sign in with your verified mobile number. Pending payments temporarily reserve an offer place.
Cannot be combined with WELCOME250, another coupon or HIDI reward redemption. One offer per order.
Prices include applicable taxes. Existing delivery charges apply.
Returns & exchanges
If returns reduce your retained qualifying merchandise below ₹3,999, the dress you keep under GET1 will be charged at its full regular selling price at the time of purchase. The ₹1 already paid will be credited; you must pay the remaining balance.
The ₹1 dress cannot be returned for a change of mind or preference. Size exchanges are allowed within 7 days of delivery, subject to replacement stock availability.
Other eligible items in the order may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Items submitted for return or size exchange must be unused, unworn and unwashed, with original tags and packaging, and are subject to inspection.
Return pickup and size exchanges are free. Size exchanges depend on replacement stock availability.
Refunds are processed within 3–5 days after inspection confirms the returned item is unused and undamaged.
For a wrong, damaged or missing item, keep the packaging, order number and clear photos. These cases are reviewed separately from preference-based returns.
